title: The Unsaid Weather
author: Lena Amberdale
blurb: Felix Vane, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
